formulas.name: AddedDays
formulas.expression: LEFT( IF(AND(NOT({!MondaySelected}), {!MondayCheckbox}), 'Monday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!TuesdaySelected}), {!TuesdayCheckbox}), 'Tuesday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!WednesdaySelected}), {!WednesdayCheckbox}), 'Wednesday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!ThursdaySelected}), {!ThursdayCheckbox}), 'Thursday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!FridaySelected}), {!FridayCheckbox}), 'Friday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!SaturdaySelected}), {!SaturdayCheckbox}), 'Saturday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!SundaySelected}), {!SundayCheckbox}), 'Sunday, ', '') , LEN( IF(AND(NOT({!MondaySelected}), {!MondayCheckbox}), 'Monday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!TuesdaySelected}), {!TuesdayCheckbox}), 'Tuesday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!WednesdaySelected}), {!WednesdayCheckbox}), 'Wednesday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!ThursdaySelected}), {!ThursdayCheckbox}), 'Thursday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!FridaySelected}), {!FridayCheckbox}), 'Friday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!SaturdaySelected}), {!SaturdayCheckbox}), 'Saturday, ', '') + IF(AND(NOT({!SundaySelected}), {!SundayCheckbox}), 'Sunday, ', '') ) - 2 )
